description: 8BitDo controller support and per-device button-layout switching for Better than Adventure! 8.0.1

mods.name: 8BitDo Controller Support
mods.description: Registers runtime GLFW gamepad mappings for every 8BitDo controller, so Better than Adventure's native controller support actually sees it.

releases.notes:
Metadata release for Mod Menu — the mod now shows its own icon and working links. No gameplay changes.

## Changed

- **Mod list icon.** The jar ships a square 256×256 icon (`icon` in `fabric.mod.json`), so Mod Menu shows the project logo instead of the generic placeholder.
- **Website** button in Mod Menu now opens the Modrinth page: <https://modrinth.com/mod/bta-8bitdo>.
- **Issues** button opens the GitHub issue tracker (<https://github.com/psampir/bta-8bitdo/issues>), and the sources link points at the repository.
- Version `1.0.1+8.0.1`; everything else is identical to `1.0.0+8.0.1` (runtime GLFW mappings for 8BitDo pads, per-device layout toggle, hot-plug).

## Install

Drop the jar into the `mods` folder of a **Babric BTA 8.0.1** instance (fabric-loader `0.18.4-bta.11`, Java 17+). Client-side only. Restart the game after updating — Mod Menu reads mod icons and metadata at startup.

## Notes

- Plain BTA 8.0.1 cannot load mods; use the Babric instance from Turnip-Labs.
- The mod hooks BTA internals (`InputHandler.initGLFW`/`poll`, `ControllerType.fromController`, `ScreenControllerSetup.init`/`tick`); a future BTA update may need matching changes.
- Full documentation: <https://github.com/psampir/bta-8bitdo>

mods.name: 8BitDo Controller Support
mods.description: Registers runtime GLFW gamepad mappings for every 8BitDo controller, so Better than Adventure's native controller support actually sees it.

releases.notes:
8BitDo controllers now work with Better than Adventure! 8.0.1's native controller support, and their button glyphs can match the shell.

## Features

- **Runtime GLFW mappings.** BTA only recognises a pad when a mapping matches its whole GUID, firmware revision included. The mod builds one from the GUID the device reports and registers it before BTA counts controllers, so the log shows `1 controllers found!` instead of `0 controllers found!`.
- **210 8BitDo entries** merged from SDL_GameControllerDB and BTA's own database, resolved by exact GUID → same bus/VID/PID → same VID/PID → XInput fallback.
- **Per-device button layout toggle** in the controller setup screen: `AUTO → XBOX 360 → NINTENDO SWITCH → AUTO`. The choice is written to `config/eightbitdo.properties` (rules on `guid:`, `name:` and `vid:pid`, `auto` to opt out) and applies immediately. Glyphs only — input is never remapped.
- **Hot-plug.** Pads attached or woken after start are picked up within a few frames.

## Install

Requires a **Babric BTA 8.0.1** instance (`bta_fabric_instance_8.0.1.zip`, fabric-loader `0.18.4-bta.11`) — plain BTA 8.0.1 cannot load mods — and Java 17+.

1. Drop `eightbitdo-1.0.0+8.0.1.jar` into the instance's `mods` folder.
2. Start the game with the controller connected; the log shows `Registered controller mapping …` and `1 controllers found!`.
3. Open *Options → Controller... → Select Controller...* and use the `Layout` button.

Client-side only: servers do not need it and cannot tell it is installed.

## Tested

BTA 8.0.1 (Babric), 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Bluetooth in 2.4G/XInput mode (`2dc8:310b`, GUID `03000000c82d00000b31000000010000`), on 2026-11-16: the Switch glyphs B/A/Y/X, the `(NINTENDO SWITCH)` type and the `Layout: NINTENDO SWITCH` button all verified in game; `tools/verify.fish` passes against the real pad.

## Limitations

- The mixins hook BTA internals (`InputHandler.initGLFW`/`poll`, `ControllerType.fromController`, `ScreenControllerSetup.init`/`tick`). A future BTA update may need matching changes; `tools/verify.fish` checks the targets with `javap`.
- The button layout is a manual choice: pads that share a USB id but ship different ABXY shells cannot be told apart.
- Only devices reporting USB vendor `0x2dc8` (8BitDo) are touched.
- Not affiliated with 8BitDo or the Better than Adventure! team.

Build instructions, the config format and the verification harness: https://github.com/psampir/bta-8bitdo
